documents.name: Revenue
documents.description: Gross sales revenue before subtracting discounts. Use SUM(revenue) for total revenue.

documents.name: Order count
documents.description: Number of sales records. Each row represents one order in the demo dataset.

documents.name: Units sold
documents.description: Total quantity of products or services sold.

documents.name: Average discount rate
documents.description: Arithmetic mean of the order-level discount fraction. Values range from 0 to 1.

documents.name: Sales region
documents.description: Geographic sales region used for grouping and comparison.

documents.name: Product category
documents.description: Commercial category of the purchased offering.

documents.name: Order month
documents.description: Calendar month derived from order_date for time-series analysis.

documents.name: Revenue interpretation
documents.description: The demo revenue field is gross revenue. Do not subtract discount again unless the user explicitly requests an estimated net value.
